 XRP crashes toward $0.99 as analyst warns of another brutal drop
 Bibhu Pattnaik Fri, November 13, 2026 at 5:30 PM EST 3 min read XRP-USD -4.22%

 Learn more XRP is back at a level it hasn't tested in three months.  
 At the time of writing, the token briefly dropped below $1 on Friday, Nov. 13, for the first time since August, touching an intraday low of $0.9967 before recovering to around $1.02. 
 The broader crypto market is under heavy pressure. Now one closely followed analyst says XRP's next move depends on a single support level.  
 XRP has slid back to the bottom of its trading range, and the analyst says the next move could get worse. 
 Selling hits the whole market 
 In an X post , crypto analyst Ali Charts said XRP failed to break above $1.55, the top of its price channel, and has now made a full reversal toward the channel's lower boundary at $0.99. 
 "Now, $0.99 must hold," he wrote. "If XRP loses this support, the correction could extend toward $0.80." 
 Related: If you invested $1,000 in Trump Media on its first day, here's what it's worth today 
 A drop to $0.80 would be about 19% below that support. 
 "XRP REVERSES ALL GAINS It happened. XRP failed to break above the $1.55 resistance at the top of the channel and has now completed a full reversal toward the channel's lower boundary at $0.99," the analyst said. 
 XRP isn't falling alone. Bitcoin dropped 6.7% to around $68,800, and crypto liquidations reached $727 million over 24 hours on Nov. 12. 
 Inflation data added to the pressure. U.S. producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, according to the latest PPI report . 
 Institutional demand has cooled too. U.S. spot XRP ETFs saw about $18 million in outflows over two sessions. 
 What Ali Charts has flagged before 
 The analyst has had $0.99 on his radar for days.  
 Earlier this month, he said XRP had broken below the channel's mid-range support, which shifted his focus to the lower boundary near $0.99. 
 His more recent call was more hopeful. As we reported on Nov. 9, he said XRP looked ready to bounce from the bottom of a month-long descending channel and could climb toward $1.30 if $1.14 held. That level has since given way. 
 In late October, citing Santiment data, he warned that XRP could fall to $0.98 if whales kept selling. 
 His latest target also echoes an August call. Back then, he named $1.06 as a make-or-break zone for XRP and said losing it could open a path toward $0.80, and potentially $0.62. 
 For now, traders are watching whether XRP can close above $0.99. The August low of $0.9852 is the next level below that.
